systems.author: fastino
systems.source: v1.4.3 addition attempt (official offline measurement on Sandy's CPU, 25 Sep 2026, jevbench-add-requests run 14)
systems.note: fastino/GLiNER2.5-Decide @ 7ee5da4c2415e32259bcdc0b1a7367c32ce8d6f6, the 340M English member of the GLiNER2.5 family, fine-tuned from fastino/gliner2-large-v1; loaded in-process with the author's own gliner2 AutoExtractor on Sandy's CPU. Measured with exactly the mapping its three siblings on the board were measured with (GLiNER2.5 small, GLiNER2.5 multi, GLiNER2 large; docs/v1.2-additions.md ‘GLiNER2 mapping’, written down before those runs): text = 'Question: <instructions>\n\n<state>' because the model has no instruction slot; labels = the option keys and their rubric text (choice), {yes: criteria.true, no: criteria.false} (noul) or the ordinal level texts (score). The distribution is the model's own single-label softmax over the per-label logits, read out in full through the documented class_act='softmax', multi_label=True, cls_threshold=0.0; the sigmoid multi-label scores are not used and nothing is renormalised by us. A schema-conditioned classifier, not a decision LM: it does not reason and its own card says so.

Distilled on SargeDev/jev-distill-corpus-v3 (655,806 rows of Jev-labelled decisions). Run through the reviewed local-only copy of the author's JevClient (pinned config/model classes, strict safetensors load, the author's fp16-on-CUDA dtype; no remote code), behind a minimal stdlib loopback wrapper because the release ships no HTTP server. Overlap audit: the full 655,806-row training corpus screened against the 231 public items — 0 exact prompt matches, 0 flagged pairs, max 8-gram containment 0.0%. The author's own 73.1% on 3,000 held-out JEV cases is his claim, not a JevBench number.
